name: lumberjack
description: Clears the overgrowth between you and the code. Compare your mental model of a codebase to how it actually works and ground your plans in that, with graded Mermaid diagrams — then hold the line on comments: one skill keeps them from being written, another cuts the ones already there.

plugins.name: lumberjack
plugins.description: Four skills in two pairs. Compares a stated mental model of a codebase against reality and grounds implementation plans in it, reporting the gaps as graded Mermaid diagrams (architecture, deployment, or data-flow). Reviews the comments already in the code and reports which to cut, worst first, and keeps new ones from being written where the code could say it instead.
